name: basic-memory
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：basic-memory。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use the Basic Memory knowledge graph for persistent memory across sessions. Search before answering; capture decisions, meetings, and insights as notes.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · Basic Memory 自家产品的集成件（路径就在 `integrations/hermes/skill`），正文通篇是 bm_* 工具表和 permalink 路由规则的产品手册。得先装那套产品才用得上，而任何 Basic Memory 用户在它自己仓库里就能拿到；再叠上一层「第 N 个记忆件」。 正文原话：**Always invoke the `bm_*` tools directly. Do not shell out to the `bm` CLI for note operations.** … The `bm_*` tools route through a persistent MCP connection
